ValidationRule.description: Prevents users in Practice Intelligence and Market Intelligence from marking Renewal or New Business opportunities as Closed Lost unless both the Closed Lost Primary Reason and Note fields are completed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: text(StageName) = "Closed Lost" && ((text(Opportunity_Type_Forecast__c) = "Renewal") || (text(Opportunity_Type_Forecast__c) = "New Business")) && ((Owner.Business_Group__c = "Practice Intelligence") || (Owner.Business_Group__c = "Market Intelligence") || (Owner.Business_Group__c = "MBL Seminars")) && NOT($Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c) && ISCHANGED(StageName) && ((ISBLANK(TEXT( Closed_Lost_primary_reason__c ))) || (ISBLANK( Note__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete both Closed Lost Primary Reason and Note before marking this opportunity as Closed Lost.
